bestBets.overview: Rosehill saw some rain early in the week and there may be a tiny bit more on Wednesday but there is some sunshine leading tot he weekend which should bring some improvement. Dare say we start proceedings on a 5 or a 4. FEDERAL RESERVE another 3rd-upper and recent winner but doesn't have the credentials further than a mile just yet. That may all change with this race though.

raceTips.comment: Proxima Dea has been racing consistently and looks well placed to continue her solid run of form, with a forward showing expected from a favourable draw and a profile that suggests she can settle close to the speed. Orange Tsunami has been building nicely through recent performances and maps to secure a comfortable position, giving the gelding every chance to produce a strong finishing effort. Federal Reserve has been competitive against similar opposition and has the right profile to improve again, with a softer run in transit likely to allow him to finish off strongly.
